newsitem.title: GERMANY: AGCO sees sales rising to $3 bln.
newsitem.headline: AGCO sees sales rising to $3 bln.

text.p: U.S. agricultural equipment maker AGCO Corp said on Wednesday it expects recent acquisitions to boost 1997 sales to more than $3 billion.
AGCO chairman Robert Ratliff told reporters the sales figure includes the German tractor maker Fendt, Deutz Argentina and Maxion in Brazil. Ratliff said he also expects cash flow to increase.
AGCO has been on a corporate buying spree, and has said it expects to spend $1.5 billion on European farm equipment acquisitions over the next five years.
Its sales in the third quarter of 1996 totaled $589 million, up from $484 million a year earlier.
AGCO does not plan to cut any of the 3,000 jobs at Fendt, which it bought this month for about 490 million marks.
